email.subject1: a signal play for dbt Labs
email.body1:
Samantha, saw dbt Labs named Snowflake's 2026 Data Integration Partner of the Year and shipping dbt Copilot into AI-assisted data ops.

Momentum like that usually opens more in-market enterprise accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals quietly stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for dbt Labs off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Samantha, quick follow-up for dbt Labs.

At enterprise scale, pipeline targets tend to climb faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings dbt Labs needs to cover this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Samantha, last bit of proof for dbt Labs.

Memgraph, a data infrastructure company, had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks.

I pulled a benchmark of how dbt Labs' reply rate likely compares to other data platform companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Samantha, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything when you are leaning into a new AI motion, and I know that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise data motion? I will tailor it to dbt Labs either way.
